Name: Tool Upgrade Costs - Fixed
Author: ADumbBagel
Description:
For some reason, a small segment of the mod code increased the 'level' of generic tools (unofficial + trash can) by one, which ends up making those tools have the wrong level and breaking them at max level. I'm not sure what that code was supposed to do, but it seems to work fine without it and removing it fixed the bug. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯[b]

[/b]ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION BELOW:

Lets you fully customize the cost and needed materials to upgrade vanilla tools.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
Run the game once to generate the config.json file, then open it in a text editor.

For each upgrade level, you can change these options:
[list]
[*]Cost: the gold cost for the upgrade.
[*]MaterialName: the name of the material needed to upgrade the item (like "Copper Bar"). Works with custom Json Assets items too.
[*]MaterialStack: the number of the material item needed. Default 5 to match vanilla.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

For Stardew Valley 1.6 or later, see the optional file on the 'Files' tab.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

Mod notes:
[list]
[*]Rush Orders:compatible.
[*]Prismatic Tools: compatible, but it won't change the prismatic tool costs.
[/list][/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.[/quote]
